title: Multi-Robot Coordination for Emergency Evacuation via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning with Complex Crowd Behavior and Dynamic Hazard Modeling
description:
Open-source Unity and ML-Agents implementation of an adversarial reinforcement learning framework for multi-robot emergency evacuation. Version 1.0.0 includes the curated final V11 Experiment II zero-shot team-size evaluation (1-5 robots, three seeds, 100 episodes per seed), frozen robot and human policies, the training configuration, seed-level and aggregate statistics, and one qualitative scene-level trajectory example.

The software is released under the MIT License. The contents of experiment_data/ are released under CC BY 4.0.
